table.name: TLGNC_SIMPLE_VEHICLE
table.description: Simple vehicles (currently ships, block trains) are used to deliver different types of orders and are owned by a carrier. Many of the fields have only informative character and are ignored by Logon.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The carrier (in German: Transporteur, Spediteur, Lieferant) who owns the vehicle.

column.name: PRIORITY
column.description: Range: 0-99. Used for ordering of the trucks. At the moment only used for ordering purposes. (later, i.e. at the moment out of scope, then also for the auto-scheduling functionality).

column.name: VEHICLE_NAME
column.description: Name (ID) of the vehicle as displayed in the UI, with formatting. This is typically a shortened form of carrier + some enumeration, but must also be unique for its type because it's used for display/selection in Logon. Example: Ernst 01.

column.name: VEHICLE_REG_NO
column.description: Vehicle registration number. Serves as alternative identifier for a vehicle and must therefore be unique per type.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NO
column.description: SAP Number of the truck. Field is going to be used in export interfaces to SAP.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: SAP Vehicle Type. In contrast to truck not linked to reference data, just a manually entered string.

column.name: SIMPLE_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: Type of the vehicle (ship, block train, ...).

column.name: VEHICLE_UNIT_COUNT
column.description: Number of units (e.g. wagons of a block train AKA unit train). Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon. No consistency check.

column.name: MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Maximal gross weight (vehicle+load). This is the legal max weight for the vehicle. Information only, no logic.

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty vehicle in tons. Information only, no logic.

column.name: VOLUME_M3
column.description: Loading volume of the vehicle in cubic meters. Information only, no logic.

column.name: BRANDING_FLAG
column.description: 0=no, 1=yes, null=unkown/does not matter. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG
column.description: Internal means owned by Crh company => relevant for costs calculation in SAP Yes/no/Null not applicable. Copied value from tlgns_sap_vehicle.

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_companycode_bs. Company code the vehicle belongs to. MUST be set if SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG is set.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude of the homebase of the vehicle. Information only, no logic.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute of the homebase of the truck. Information only, no logic.
